title: A Need Grows in Brooklyn
subtitle: Television Series / Feature Film
logline: In Brooklyn's tough streets of the 1990s, a group of teenage friends hustle for money, girls, and respect -- until reckless choices force them to confront the cost of their lifestyle.
detail:
A neo-realist crime drama shot handheld. Mean Streets meets Kids. Period-accurate Brooklyn and Manhattan locations, authentic dialect, naturalistic performances. The weight of consequence in a world that moves too fast and asks too little.

The project exists as both a (212) Pictures television series (10 episodes) and a New Renaissance Cinema standalone feature film.
